'''Post 473''' was a designation given to a [[Unidentified clone trooper (Post 473)|clone trooper]] that was assigned with destroying a bridge in order to prevent a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] army from conquering a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony on a [[Unidentified planet (Post 473)|planet]].

{{Alias-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Post 473 designation first appeared in the short story ''[[Waiting]]'', which was one of four stories in the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures Volume 10|tenth volume]] of the [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (graphic novels)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] [[Star Wars comic books|trade paperbacks]]. It was created by [[Matthew Fillbach|Matthew]] and [[Shawn Fillbach]].
